summary: Ranks own monotone contiguous row/CSR slices. Preprocessing partitions every local row into reordered SELL or original-order long-row CSR without dropping entries. Each requested timed iteration submits both applicable kernels on separate streams. The long-row kernel multiplies all tiled entries then sums in original order; SELL consumes all row entries, ignoring only padding. Stream join, copy and MPI gather complete before the end clock.
